extracted.intended_audience: public company investor relations, corporate communications, and legal/compliance teams
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for preparing corporate earnings press releases and the related SEC Form 8-K filing, including what events trigger an 8-K, required disclosures for earnings releases, standard press-release format, and distribution/filing best practices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Form 8-K filing timeliness
rubrics_metrics.description: Public companies must file Form 8-K within four business days of a material event.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Timely filing ensures investors have current information for informed decisions; 4-business-day deadline is a regulatory requirement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Form 8-K format and itemization
rubrics_metrics.description: Form 8-K is a regulatory filing with specific format requirements and standardized item numbers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the correct item numbers and structure required by the SEC; Form 8-K filings are publicly available on EDGAR.

rubrics_metrics.name: Press release as corporate narrative
rubrics_metrics.description: Press release is the company's own narrative and is marketing-aware in framing company news.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tailor messaging for the market and media while ensuring factual accuracy; press releases are typically distributed via wire services to reach financial press.

rubrics_metrics.name: Simultaneous announcement practice
rubrics_metrics.description: Common practice is to announce results via press release while filing the press release as an exhibit to an 8-K, often alongside a conference call announcement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Coordinate timing so the press release distribution and 8-K filing occur together; include conference call logistics and IR contacts to support investor engagement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Acquisitions or asset sales (8-K trigger)
rubrics_metrics.description: An acquisition or sale of assets is a material event triggering Form 8-K disclosure.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe the transaction, parties, material terms, financial impact and any required exhibits or agreements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Bankruptcy (8-K trigger)
rubrics_metrics.description: Filing for bankruptcy or significant bankruptcy-related developments require Form 8-K disclosure.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Disclose status, implications for operations and creditors, and any material agreements or proceedings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Executive changes (8-K trigger)
rubrics_metrics.description: Resignations, appointments, or other changes involving CEO, CFO, or directors are material events needing an 8-K.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide dates, reasons, any related arrangements (severance, employment agreements) and biographies for successors as applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Auditor changes (8-K trigger)
rubrics_metrics.description: Termination or engagement of an auditor requires Form 8-K disclosure.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explain reasons for the change, any disagreements with outgoing auditor, and any reportable events.

rubrics_metrics.name: Delisting notices (8-K trigger)
rubrics_metrics.description: Notices regarding delisting or transfer of listing status are material and must be disclosed via Form 8-K.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include the nature of the notice, regulatory actions, and expected timing or impact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Material agreements (entry/termination) (8-K trigger)
rubrics_metrics.description: Entering into or terminating material definitive agreements requires an 8-K filing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: File the agreement as an exhibit when required and summarize key commercial and financial terms in the filing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Direct financial obligations (8-K trigger)
rubrics_metrics.description: Material changes to direct financial obligations (e.g., debt issuances, defaults) trigger 8-K disclosure.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe the obligation, terms, counterparty, and financial impact on liquidity and covenant compliance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Off-balance-sheet arrangements (8-K trigger)
rubrics_metrics.description: Material off-balance-sheet arrangements must be disclosed on Form 8-K.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explain nature, exposure, and implications for financial statements and risk.

rubrics_metrics.name: Costs of restructuring (8-K trigger)
rubrics_metrics.description: Material restructuring costs or plans require Form 8-K disclosure.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Quantify costs, expected timing, affected operations, and accounting treatment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Material impairments (8-K trigger)
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizing material impairment charges is a reportable event on Form 8-K.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Disclose amounts, affected assets or goodwill, and rationale for impairment testing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Earnings releases as material events (8-K trigger)
rubrics_metrics.description: Earnings releases are considered material events and often trigger a Form 8-K filing (Item for earnings releases).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include core financial highlights and file the release as an exhibit when applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Regulation FD disclosures (8-K trigger)
rubrics_metrics.description: Certain Regulation FD disclosures may require Form 8-K reporting if they are material.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure compliance with Reg FD when disclosing material non-public information and file Form 8-K when a public disclosure is made.

rubrics_metrics.name: Code of ethics changes (8-K trigger)
rubrics_metrics.description: Amendments to the code of ethics or waivers for officers/directors require disclosure via Form 8-K.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe the change or waiver and the individuals involved, as required by SEC rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Amendments to bylaws (8-K trigger)
rubrics_metrics.description: Material amendments to corporate bylaws must be reported on Form 8-K.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide details of amendments and their expected governance impact.

rubrics_metrics.name: GAAP financial highlights
rubrics_metrics.description: Earnings press releases should include GAAP financial highlights.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Present clear GAAP metrics (revenue, net income, EPS) as the primary financial disclosure; avoid burying GAAP figures behind non-GAAP emphasis.

rubrics_metrics.name: Non-GAAP reconciliation (Reg G compliance)
rubrics_metrics.description: Press releases that present non-GAAP measures must include reconciliations to the most directly comparable GAAP measures in compliance with Regulation G.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide clear, labeled reconciliation tables and explanation of the adjustments; avoid misleading prominence of non-GAAP measures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Comparative periods (yoy, sequential)
rubrics_metrics.description: Include comparative periods (year‑over‑year and sequential comparisons) when presenting results.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide consistent comparative data to aid investor analysis and trend assessment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Segment disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: Press releases should disclose segment-level information where material.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Summarize segment performance and direct readers to detailed segment disclosures in filings and financial statements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Forward guidance (if provided)
rubrics_metrics.description: If the company provides forward guidance, it should be clearly labeled and quantified where possible.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include the basis and assumptions for guidance and reconcile to historical performance; consider whether guidance triggers additional disclosures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Forward-looking statements safe harbor
rubrics_metrics.description: Include safe harbor language for forward-looking statements in the press release.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use standard forward-looking disclaimer language to identify risks and cautionary statements protecting against reliance on future projections.

rubrics_metrics.name: Headline (top-line financial summary)
rubrics_metrics.description: Start with a headline that communicates the top-line financial summary.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Make the headline concise and factual (e.g., revenue and EPS highlights); avoid speculative claims in the headline.

rubrics_metrics.name: Subhead (key highlights)
rubrics_metrics.description: Use a subhead to present key highlights supporting the headline.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide one or two lines with the most important context or metrics that expand on the headline.

rubrics_metrics.name: Bulleted summary of metrics
rubrics_metrics.description: Include a bulleted summary of key metrics for quick scanning by readers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Cover core KPIs such as revenue, EPS, revenue growth, and any notable metrics like ARR or EBITDA if material.

rubrics_metrics.name: Lead paragraph
rubrics_metrics.description: Open with a lead paragraph summarizing the quarter/period and the most material outcomes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Answer who, what, when, where, and the material financial result in the lead; keep it tight and factual.

rubrics_metrics.name: CEO commentary (quote)
rubrics_metrics.description: Include a CEO (or other executive) quote providing context and strategic perspective.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the quote to contextualize results and outlook, but avoid forward-looking assertions without appropriate disclaimers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Detailed financial discussion
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a more detailed narrative discussion of financial results following the summary.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explain drivers of revenue and expense changes, unusual items, and comparability issues; reference the full financial statements and MD&A in filings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Segment results (detailed)
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide detailed results for business segments where relevant.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Show contribution to revenue and operating income by segment and explain significant movements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cash flow and balance sheet highlights
rubrics_metrics.description: Summarize cash flow and balance sheet highlights in the release.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include key liquidity metrics, debt levels, and changes in cash position that are material to investors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Outlook / guidance section
rubrics_metrics.description: If given, include an outlook or guidance section describing expected future performance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State guidance ranges, key assumptions, and sensitivity to market conditions; pair with safe harbor language for forward-looking content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conference call details
rubrics_metrics.description: Include conference call (earnings call) logistics: date, time, dial-in/webcast, and replay information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide access information prominently and include how to obtain supplemental materials (slides, financial tables).

rubrics_metrics.name: Non-GAAP reconciliation tables (exhibit)
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide non-GAAP reconciliation tables as part of the release or as an exhibit.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tables should be clear, labeled, and reconcilable to GAAP numbers; ensure Reg G compliance when non-GAAP measures are presented.

rubrics_metrics.name: About the company section
rubrics_metrics.description: Include a brief 'About the company' boilerplate describing business and operations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Keep the boilerplate consistent quarter-to-quarter and include website and core business descriptors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Investor relations contact information
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide IR contact(s) for investor and media inquiries at the end of the release.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Separate investor contacts from media contacts and include phone, email, and relevant web links.

rubrics_metrics.name: Clarity of material information
rubrics_metrics.description: Material information must be disclosed clearly in the press release and/or 8-K.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Avoid ambiguous language; present material facts plainly so investors can make informed decisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Completeness of required SEC disclosures
rubrics_metrics.description: Press releases and filings must include all required SEC disclosures relevant to the event.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Cross-check items against SEC Form 8-K requirements to ensure no reportable item is omitted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consistency quarter-to-quarter
rubrics_metrics.description: Maintain a consistent format from quarter to quarter for comparability.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Standardize headings, metric presentation, and reconciliation placement to facilitate investor analysis and trend tracking.

rubrics_metrics.name: Separate investor and media contacts
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide distinct contacts for investors and for media inquiries.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensures appropriate handling of financial questions vs. PR/media requests and supports Reg FD compliance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Distribution via Reg FD-compliant channels
rubrics_metrics.description: Distribute material information via channels compliant with Regulation FD to ensure fair public dissemination.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use recognized wire services or simultaneous broad public disclosure mechanisms; avoid selective disclosures to analysts or select investors without Reg FD compliance.
